messages.content: What is the Substrate Agent Platform module?

The Substrate Agent Platform (id: substrate) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It runs as a background system. The Substrate Agent Platform (substrate_agent_platform.py) is a Python background system that orchestrates multi-agent consensus loops, triggers biomimetic simulations (AlphaFold/AlphaGenome), queries the semantic memory graph, and updates persistent databases. It runs autonomously without direct user intervention.
What is the Substrate Agent Platform?

The Substrate Agent Platform (substrate_agent_platform.py) is a Python background system that orchestrates multi-agent consensus loops, triggers biomimetic simulations (AlphaFold/AlphaGenome), queries the semantic memory graph, and updates persistent databases. It runs autonomously without direct user intervention.
What does the Substrate Platform do autonomously?

It runs scheduled tasks like: genome sequence analysis, protein structure prediction via AlphaFold, semantic graph maintenance, noospheric calibration checks, and scheduled memory consolidation — all without requiring user input.
How does the Substrate Agent Platform module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Reads/writes all Jarvis memory JSON files. Triggers biomimetic simulations. Runs as Python subprocess from the main server.
